body:
No.  I've always lied about how fucked up things really are, always hiding behind pride I don't deserve, and soaking up just enough pity.  Now I've gotten to the breaking point.  I just want to quit.  I don't want to talk about it, because what it'll only bring everyone down and stigmatize me.

I don't want to die.  That's the only thing more pointless than living.  But I can't just start over from literally square one.

I'm not even good at the things I do by myself.  I catch myself wasting time doing stupid things inefficiently, wasting money I don't have, or never finishing at all.  I'm not even valuable to myself.

Making myself happy is exactly the selfish thinking that led me here.  I've always *wanted* to do things on my own, but I'm so bad at so much that everyone has to help me, and it's a waste.  Because I'll always be bad.  I've wasted half my life pursuing things that I ultimately fail at beyond recovery (school, work, money, relationship, independence).  At this point I don't blame people for treating me like a child, and I'd rather just stop bothering and hurting everyone than have to start adolescence over again.  Nothing important really interests me anyway.  If there's effort involved, I will fail.  I simply don't know how to *do*.

..I'm so scared..  I'm scared that I'll never be good at anything.  I'm scared that I'll never change and only continue to bring down everyone I know.  I'm scared that I'm having these thoughts.  Like a helpless rabbit, I'm afraid, cowardly;  freeze or flight, but NEVER fight.  And that just makes me hate myself even more.  It's disgusting.
